name: one-line-assembler
title: FRISC-V Debug Tools
author: PhilippDahlinger
description: Debug tools for the FRISC-V CPU. One line assembler: a constant combinator that assembles one RISC-V (RV32IMB + Zicsr + mret/wfi/sret/sfence.vma) instruction and outputs its machine code on signal D. Register display: a display panel that shows all 32 registers (decimal, hex, binary) of the register memory cell it is wired to.
